summary: The first source loss is the #wear completion turn for HELM_OF_TELEPATHY. C do_wear.c:Helmet_on() explicitly treats this type as a no-extra-effect case and reaches its common known/inventory tail; JavaScript rejects the type in helmetOnPorted() and accessory_or_armor_on() before setworn() and the delayed callback. C and JavaScript both already own the TELEPAT worn property/range and monster redraw path. The complete source task is a file-port of Helmet_on(), including its other omitted branches, with adj_abon() completed for HELM_OF_BRILLIANCE and the command/startup callback admission wired.

source.branch: When an unworn HELM_OF_TELEPATHY is selected through #wear outside the quest-level restriction, canwearobj() and retouch_object() succeed, accessory_or_armor_on() installs W_ARMH and schedules Helmet_on() after the helm's one-turn oc_delay. The C switch takes the explicit HELM_OF_TELEPATHY no-extra-effect arm, then marks the helm known and updates inventory if needed.
callers: do_wear.c:dowear() -> accessory_or_armor_on() -> delayed Helmet_on() callback; JavaScript command W -> js/do_wear.js:dowear() -> accessory_or_armor_on().
hack.c:unmul() invokes ga.afternmv after the dressing delay and discards Helmet_on()'s int result; JavaScript js/hack.js:unmul() invokes state.afternmv.

do_wear.c:set_wear() directly calls Helmet_on() for a starting or changed uarmh; allmain.c:moveloop_preamble() calls set_wear(NULL), and zap.c:poly_obj() calls set_wear(otmp) after a worn object transforms. JavaScript reaches these through js/moveloop_preamble.js or js/zap.js into js/do_wear.js:set_wear().
do_wear.c:Helmet_on() and Helmet_off(), Gloves_on(), Gloves_off() call adj_abon(); the current JavaScript helper has the glove arm but not C's HELM_OF_BRILLIANCE arm.
dependencies: do_wear.c:adj_abon() (3319-3337) is required for the whole Helmet_on() scope: its HELM_OF_BRILLIANCE arm marks the helm known, adjusts INT/WIS by spe, and sets disp.botl. Its C return is void and all callers discard it; js/do_wear.js:adj_abon() currently implements only the GAUNTLETS_OF_DEXTERITY arm.

worn.c:setworn() installs the helm slot and TELEPAT extrinsic before Helmet_on(); worn.c:recalc_telepat_range() sets the range from worn TELEPAT sources. Both are void state updates and are present in js/worn.js.

allmain.c:moveloop_core() redraws monsters when Unblind_telepat is active at 462-467; display.c:tp_sensemon()/sensemon() reads TELEPAT and unblind_telepat_range. The corresponding js/allmain.js and js/display.js paths exist at the examined commit; Helmet_on() must not add a redundant see_monsters() call to the telepathy arm.

Helmet_on() returns 0, ignored by both set_wear() and unmul(). No C callee return value is consumed by Helmet_on(); accessory_or_armor_on() separately returns ECMD_TIME to dowear() after scheduling the delayed action.
